charts.title: Kepler-1939 b: orbits around Kepler-1939
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-1939's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-1939 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.
